claim_scope: Not a canonical controlled A/B and not pooled with Claude/Qwen canonical harness results.

protocol_deviation.reason: The known Codex subscription /fast no-op recurred: both CoC arms requested fast and both provider receipts reported default. Because the actual tier was identical, the outputs are retained; later cells omit the dead convenience flag.
protocol_deviation.inference: Tier is excluded as an experimental variable. Accuracy remains paired at provider-reported default; latency is reported as default-tier latency. No cell is rerun solely for this receipt mismatch.

objective: Combine the bounded-matter accuracy of complete reads with the large-corpus accuracy and efficiency of targeted legal retrieval, without classifying task wording or legal domain.

prior_evidence.coverage_finalist_v1: Beat pinned upstream Mike 444/548 to 432/548 across nine LAB tasks, but used 1.41x tokens and failed the preregistered regression guard on change-of-control and tax after reading 0.92M and 1.17M source characters completely.
prior_evidence.targeted_change_of_control: The earlier targeted hybrid scored 52/57 with about 338k tokens, versus 47/57 for upstream and 43/57 for the v1 complete-read hybrid.
prior_evidence.complete_read_counterexample: The current complete-read hybrid scored 72/83 on indenture drafting versus 71/83 upstream, while an earlier targeted indenture run scored 56/83. The primary precedent and drafting scaffold therefore must remain eligible for complete reads.
prior_evidence.correctness_defect: Glob claimed to report extracted character and line counts but returned filenames only. V2 fixes the model-facing contract before either arm runs.

held_constant.performer_route: Codex subscription backend using the existing flat-rate provider adapter
held_constant.service_tier_requested: fast on the first CoC pair, omitted thereafter
held_constant.handoff_cap_policy: exact; the former undocumented 2x auto-carry exception is removed
held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

coverage_soft_v2.purpose: Minimal ablation: test whether truthful inventory sizes and neutral model guidance are sufficient.
coverage_soft_v2.policy: The model may choose complete fetch_documents reads, Grep plus bounded Read, or both. The host does not enforce a whole-read budget.

coverage_hybrid_v2.purpose: General mixed-coverage policy with one context-economic guardrail.
coverage_hybrid_v2.policy: Complete-document reads share a cumulative 800000-character budget for the turn. A projected overage returns a typed selection_required receipt without exposing partial text. Grep and bounded Read remain available for supporting evidence beyond that budget.

budget_rationale.basis: Reuse the 800000-character exact-evidence cap registered before the v1 matrix. The value is fixed for the held-constant performer model; it was not selected from a task name, keyword, or desired route.
budget_rationale.shipping_note: A production budget should eventually come from provider context capabilities and measured usable-context policy. This experiment tests the behavior before adding that capability plumbing.

sentinel_matrix.reason: Large exhaustive contract set where targeted retrieval previously won decisively.
Largest source union and a v1 accuracy regression.
Large drafting task where complete precedent coverage beat targeted retrieval.
Medium source union where v1 complete coverage gained seven criteria.
Medium-large synthesis task where v1 complete coverage gained five criteria.

run_policy.performer_calls: Run both v2 arms once on every sentinel before changing either arm.
run_policy.scoring: Use the same fixed Codex gpt-5.6-sol LAB judge for both v2 arms and the existing uniformly judged upstream/v1 cells.
run_policy.expansion: Expand the winning v2 lane to the remaining four registered LAB tasks only after the sentinel gate is assessed.

primary_gate.accuracy: Across the five sentinels, the selected v2 lane must exceed pinned upstream Mike in total criteria and unweighted mean task pass rate.
primary_gate.large_context: The selected lane must not trail upstream on the combined change-of-control plus tax criteria total.
primary_gate.preservation: It may not trail upstream by more than five percentage points on any sentinel.
primary_gate.efficiency: Among lanes that clear accuracy, prefer lower total tokens, source exposure, tool calls, and latency in that order. Efficiency cannot excuse lower accuracy.

ablation_questions: Does truthful source sizing alone cause the soft lane to stop reading oversized corpora completely?
Does the hard lane use its budget for primary instruments and Grep/Read for supporting sources, rather than repeatedly testing the guard?
Does either lane preserve the complete-read gains on DPA, HSR, and the indenture precedent?
Are any misses caused by retrieval absence, handoff selection, context attention, drafting, deterministic repair, or judge noise?
Does cumulative whole-read enforcement materially reduce context and tokens without reducing accuracy?
